messages:
Lina (marketing): Quick ask from launch content: can runtime run a tiny smoke+sanity bench we can cite in the blog? Need cold-cache vs warm, p50/p95, tokens/sec, and a cheap quantized compare.

Ben (eng-runtime): Sure — what's in-scope (models, payloads, traffic shape)? Prefer to keep each cohort to 60-90s steady-state to reduce noise.

Lina (marketing): Models: redwood-m30b-fp16 (baseline), redwood-m30b-q4_0, redwood-m30b-int8. Payloads: short prompt (30 tokens), doc-summarize long (2k context + 256 query), single-sentence embed-proxy (60 tokens). Traffic: 12 clients, 80 rps target, 75s duration; discard first 20s.

Rafi (marketing): Can you also produce a tiny anonymized request/response per cohort for the blog code block? Keep headers scrubbed.

Kavya (eng-runtime): Noted. Clarify cold-cache = model resident but KV/prefix cleared, warm = prefix warmed. Cold-VM (full instance boot) optional — it's noisy but we can run it if you want. Which do you prefer?

Lina (marketing): Prioritize cold-cache. Do cold-VM only if it’s quick. Also include cost estimate per 1M tokens using current billing rates.

Ben (eng-runtime): We'll capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, errors, and CPU/GPU utilization samples. We'll push raw CSVs, a short README with exact commands, and a one-sentence recommendation for slides (if numbers support it). ETA: first artifacts in ~4h.

ci-bot: Bench job queued: #3198881234 -> pool:dedicated-2 (models: redwood-m30b-fp16,redwood-m30b-q4_0,redwood-m30b-int8). Artifacts path pending.

Kavya (eng-runtime): Running warm cohort now (short prompt). Command: ```bash
bench/run_microbench.sh --model redwood-m30b-q4_0 --cohort short --clients 12 --rps 80 --duration 75 --discard 20
```

Ben (eng-runtime): First-pass short prompt results (warm): fp16 p95=160ms tokens/s=680, q4 p95=175ms tokens/s=840, int8 p95=210ms tokens/s=1080. Uploaded raw CSV to gs://redwood-benchmarks/3198881234/short/

Lina (marketing): Nice. If int8 pushes tokens/s high but tail latency grows, call it out — we want honest tradeoffs in the blog.

Kavya (eng-runtime): Will do. Also adding a tiny sample response per cohort into artifacts (PII scrubbed).

Ben (eng-runtime): Summary artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-benchmarks/3198881234/summary.json. README includes methodology: 1) warmup discard 20s; 2) steady-state window calculation; 3) quantization flags used; 4) cost calc formula.

ci-bot: Artifacts ready at gs://redwood-benchmarks/3198881234/ (summary.json, raw/*.csv, samples/).

Rafi (marketing): Perfect — Lina and I will draft the blog snippet. Ping here if you see any >15% throughput regressions vs fp16 or >25% tail increases, otherwise we’ll proceed.

Kavya (eng-runtime): Agreed. We'll re-run any combo that hits those thresholds. If we see anomalies we'll call them out and include the specific run commands + timestamps in the README for reproducibility.

Lina (marketing): Thanks all. Please paste the single-sentence recommendation into the README so I can copy it verbatim for slide notes. :heart:
